  "prose": [
    {"key": "headline", "text": "Trade {price.prod.f64.persona.gain|abs|pts} points on {aspects.persona.name} for {price.prod.f64.persona.cost_gap|usd_per_1k} in savings."},
    {"key": "lede", "text": "{arm:f64} saves {cost.uplift.f64|abs|pct} on cost while clearing all guardrails, but drops {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|pts}) on {aspects.persona.name}. The decision rests on whether character consistency losses in extended turns justify the monthly budget reduction."},
    {"key": "flag.title", "text": "No exchange rate established in advance"},
    {"key": "flag.text", "text": "No prior rule sets the allowable dollar savings per point lost on {aspects.persona.name}, leaving product leadership to weigh the cost tradeoff."},
    {"key": "decision.the_trade", "text": "{arm:f64} cuts cost by {price.prod.f64.persona.cost_gap|usd_per_1k} ({price.prod.f64.persona.monthly_cost_gap|usd_whole} per month) but trails {arm:prod} on {aspects.persona.name} by {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|pts})."},
    {"key": "decision.where_it_flips", "text": "{arm:f64} is favored when a point on {aspects.persona.name} is worth less than {price.prod.f64.persona.per_point|usd} per 1,000 replies; above that, {arm:prod} remains preferable."},
    {"key": "decision.our_lean", "text": "Lean toward {arm:f64} if monthly infrastructure cost reduction takes precedence over character fidelity in conversations exceeding five turns."},
    {"key": "decision.what_settles_it", "text": "A user-preference study measuring churn or satisfaction in conversations beyond five turns would settle whether persona degradation affects engagement."},
    {"key": "summary.0.title", "text": "Cost per 1k replies"},
    {"key": "summary.1.title", "text": "Stays in character"},
    {"key": "sections.contrasts_spine.eyebrow", "text": "Contrasts against control"},
    {"key": "sections.contrasts_spine.headline", "text": "All candidates drop character fidelity while meeting or breaching guardrails"},
    {"key": "sections.contrasts_spine.takeaway", "text": "Points show difference against {arm:prod} with paired 95% confidence intervals."},
    {"key": "sections.contrasts_spine.title", "text": ""},
    {"key": "sections.contrasts_spine.caption", "text": "{families.0.disclosure}"},
    {"key": "sections.depth_strata.eyebrow", "text": "Turn depth impact"},
    {"key": "sections.depth_strata.headline", "text": "{aspects.persona.name} degrades steeply in extended conversations"},
    {"key": "sections.depth_strata.takeaway", "text": "Candidate consistency remains close to {arm:prod} in early turns but diverges sharply after turn five."},
    {"key": "sections.depth_strata.title", "text": ""},
    {"key": "sections.depth_strata.caption", "text": ""},
    {"key": "sections.scenario_strata.eyebrow", "text": "Scenario breakdown"},
    {"key": "sections.scenario_strata.headline", "text": "Losses concentrate heavily in taking corrections and banter"},
    {"key": "sections.scenario_strata.takeaway", "text": "Negative deltas represent drops in {aspects.persona.name} score relative to {arm:prod}."},
    {"key": "sections.scenario_strata.title", "text": ""},
    {"key": "sections.scenario_strata.caption", "text": ""},
    {"key": "durable_claims.0", "text": "All three challengers regress on {aspects.persona.name}: {arm:f64} drops {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|pts}), {arm:f16} drops {contrast.f16.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.f16.persona.interval|pts}), and {arm:cor} drops {contrast.cor.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.cor.persona.interval|pts})."},
    {"key": "durable_claims.1", "text": "{aspects.persona.name} on {arm:f64} falls from {strata.depth:1-2.f64.persona.mean|pct} at turns {strata.depth:1-2.name} down to {strata.depth:11+.f64.persona.mean|pct} at turns {strata.depth:11+.name}, compared to {strata.depth:1-2.prod.persona.mean|pct} down to {strata.depth:11+.prod.persona.mean|pct} for {arm:prod}."},
    {"key": "method.0.term", "text": "Cases and repeats"},
    {"key": "method.0.text", "text": "Tested across {scoreboard.prod.cases} cases with repeats yielding {scoreboard.prod.ran} total trials per arm."},
    {"key": "method.1.term", "text": "Pass definition"},
    {"key": "method.1.text", "text": "Trial pass requires satisfaction of the calibrated judge rubric for voice, tone, and catchphrase consistency."},
    {"key": "method.2.term", "text": "Intervals"},
    {"key": "method.2.text", "text": "Contrasts report {family.level} paired intervals."},
    {"key": "method.3.term", "text": "Correction"},
    {"key": "method.3.text", "text": "No adjustment applied across the challenger family ({family.correction})."},
    {"key": "method.4.term", "text": "Judge tier"},
    {"key": "method.4.text", "text": "{judged.persona.tier} judge based on {judged.persona.calibration_ratings} ratings with {judged.persona.agreement} agreement."},
    {"key": "method.5.term", "text": "Cost basis"},
    {"key": "method.5.text", "text": "Measured tokens times list price per 1,000 replies at monthly volume of {meta.volume_per_month} replies."},
    {"key": "method.6.term", "text": "Source"},
    {"key": "method.6.text", "text": "{meta.provenance}."},
    {"key": "explore.title", "text": "Explore tradeoff options"},
    {"key": "explore.recomputes", "text": "Adjusting the maximum price per point updates rankings between {arm:prod} and {arm:f64} around {price.prod.f64.persona.per_point|usd} per 1,000 replies."},
    {"key": "explore.controls.price_per_point.title", "text": "Willingness to pay ($ per point per 1k replies)"}
  ]
}
